note: Attacker-controlled raw bytes are deserialized as a CDR-encoded DDS_XTypes_TypeMapping, producing a typemap with identifier/object pairs.
Iterates over complete type identifier/object pairs; the crafted pair contains a PLAIN_MAP_SMALL (160) type identifier.
The crafted PLAIN_MAP_SMALL type identifier is classified as a complete type ID, so the branch is taken.
Creates a proxy type object for the complete type ID; the proxy holds a reference to the type.
Adds the complete type object to the proxy type; this triggers ddsi_xt_type_add_typeobj and ddsi_xt_type_init_impl.
For the PLAIN_MAP_SMALL type ID, the element_identifier is a valid EK_COMPLETE hash, so ddsi_type_register_dep succeeds and creates element type E with refcount 1.
The key_identifier is a TK_NONE (0) type ID; ddsi_type_register_dep fails because the type ID is 'none', returning an error.
Error path unrefs element_type E, dropping its refcount from 1 to 0, which frees E. The pointer xt->_u.map.c.element_type is NOT set to NULL.
On failure, ddsi_xt_type_fini is called with include_typeid=true; this walks the map's members and unrefs element_type AGAIN.
Second unref of the already-freed element type E; the dangling pointer is dereferenced, causing a heap-use-after-free READ 4.
The freed element type's refcount field is read from freed memory, triggering the ASan heap-use-after-free READ 4 crash.
